name: Inamoto Minoru
source:
Protagonist of the game and husband, friend, colleague... or son, brother, father of the heroines.

[spoiler]If [url=https://vndb.org/c62192]Hatsune[/url] is his sister, they lost their virginities together long time ago when Hatsune had her two arms broken and when they were teenagers. He don't have this kind of relationship with the two other characters even if they are also his sisters (with the cheats).[/spoiler]
